entities.title: zazz-worker source
entities.summary: The source of zazz-worker: four subcommands (compile, serve, test, version) over one wasmtime engine that runs each call in a fresh instance with WASI preview 1 and the zazz_host imports.
entities.purpose: main.rs parses the subcommand; engine.rs holds the one engine configuration used both to precompile and to load modules, the import allowlist and the epoch ticker; run.rs builds a store with memory and time limits, links WASI preview 1 and the five zazz_host functions (request_len, take, send, http, cancelled) and runs _start once; serve.rs reads the control socket on fd 3 and the module on fd 4 and answers each call frame from a fresh instance; testrun.rs runs a script's test module, one instance per libtest test, and reports as JSON; net.rs checks each request against the network policy and sends it through ureq, or answers it from a replay file in tests.
boundaries: Everything a run may touch arrives from zazzled: preopened directories, network policy, arguments, environment and limits in the hello frame, and the caller's three descriptors with each call.
Filesystem access is only what WASI preopens give; network access only through zazz_host.http after the policy check; nothing can start a process.
Frames, messages, descriptor passing and the HTTP wire layout are zazz-sdk's (lib zazz); this folder only uses them.
